dataset_type: Synthetic noisy-spectrum dataset for supervised recovery

noise_generation.method: Heteroskedastic Gaussian measurement noise scaled from normalized_uncertainty plus optional smooth correlated systematic component.
noise_generation.correlated_component: Gaussian-smoothed random field scaled locally by empirical uncertainty; zero mean per realization.

leakage_prevention.near_duplicate_check: Residual correlation is checked by unit tests on independently generated samples.

scientific_limitations: The reference spectrum is a stitched observational reference candidate, not analytical ground truth.
The generator models measurement noise statistically and cannot reproduce every JWST detector or reduction systematic.
The correlated component is a controlled stochastic proxy, not a calibrated instrument noise covariance matrix.
Synthetic training data are conditional on the supplied reference candidate and do not provide independent atmospheric truth.
No atmospheric molecular features are added or claimed by the generator.
